question: On which worldly and brahminical occasions do festival rites fall?
premises: at sun-moon eclipse beginning, even worldly festivals and feasts hold
inference: Eclipse, feast, marriage and brahmin sacrifice are festival occasions.
uncertainties: laukika (worldly) festivals kept distinct from srauta ones
plain_english: At sun-moon eclipse beginning, even worldly festivals, at festival and marriage and the rest, in brahmins sacrifice-act.
